name: inCod Order Status Timeline for WooCommerce
author: Marco De Sangro

sections.description:
inCod Order Status Timeline for WooCommerce displays an elegant, responsive progress bar showing customer order stages in real time.

Key Features

  • 3 Custom Layouts: Numeric Stepper, Progress Bar with percentage, and Modern Floating Capsule.
  • Automated Hook Injection or manual Shortcode placement.
  • Customizable color palettes via Admin settings.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce My Account order views and customer HTML emails.
  • Zero external script dependencies and optimized for fast page loads.

Layouts

  • Numeric Stepper – Classic step circles with numbers and connecting lines.
  • Progress Bar – Continuous bar with percentage calculation.
  • Modern Capsule – App-style floating pills with pulse animation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload incod-order-status-timeline-woocommerce to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate via WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Configure settings under WooCommerce > Timeline Ordine.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce 6.0 or higher is required.

Can I use the shortcode in custom pages?

Yes, use [order_status_timeline order_id="123"] or let it auto-detect the order on My Account pages.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes, it includes a .pot file and is fully translation-ready.
